items.title: McCormick and Unilever deal one step closer: US approves, now it’s up to the UK
items.summary: McCormick has cleared a major hurdle in the United States regarding its planned acquisition of Unilever's food business. However, the transaction has not yet been finalized, as the British competition authority is still investigating the deal.

items.title: PepsiCo plans cost cuts as North American struggles persist
items.summary: CEO Ramon Laguarta said the company plans to raise prices on select offerings and evaluate “every cost with aggressive lenses.”

items.title: PrimaPrix closes all stores in Lille, France
items.summary: The Spanish discount retailer PrimaPrix is closing its three stores in Lille, northern France. As a result, the French store network will shrink from 31 to 28 locations; this marks the first major downsizing since the chain launched in France in 2022.

items.title: Carlsberg proposes to shut Marston’s brewery in UK
items.summary: Danish brewing giant Carlsberg has set out plans to close its Marston's brewery in the UK, pointing to a weak ale market.

items.title: Price war with Coca-Cola leads to empty shelves at Aldi Germany
items.summary: At Aldi in Germany, Coca-Cola supplies are running low at several stores. The discount retailer has temporarily scaled back its orders following another price increase.

items.title: High costs are causing concern at PepsiCo
items.summary: Despite a better-than-expected third quarter, PepsiCo is lowering its full-year guidance due to persistently weak demand for snacks and beverages in North America and sharply rising costs.

items.title: Uniqlo’s parent company, Fast Retailing, surprises with fifth consecutive increase in profits
items.summary: Fast Retailing closed its fiscal year with its fifth consecutive record profit. The owner of Uniqlo attributes this to strong performance across all regions, despite pressure from the weak yen in its home market.

items.title: Italian group Morato acquires German peer Jaus Bakery
items.summary: Morato Group has acquired German bakery business Jaus Bakery and its Italian distributor CEA Italia. The financial terms were not disclosed. The post Italian group Morato acquires German peer Jaus Bakery appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Rethinking The Value Chain: An Interview With Ahmad Tea
items.summary: Zahra Afshar, head of sustainability at Ahmad Tea, discusses why European FMCG brands must look closer at their source.

items.title: Premier Group’s RFG acquisition faces regulatory hurdle over plant closure
items.summary: South Africa’s competition regulator is seeking to revoke Premier Group's acquisition of RFG Holdings amid plans to close a factory. The post Premier Group’s RFG acquisition faces regulatory hurdle over plant closure appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: “We wanted to rocket fuel our growth” – Borough Broth CEO Ros Heathcote on funding, GLP-1s and AI
items.summary: Borough Broth founder and CEO Ros Heathcote chats with Just Food on the plans ahead, the protein trend and operational challenges. The post “We wanted to rocket fuel our growth” – Borough Broth CEO Ros Heathcote on funding, GLP-1s and AI appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: PepsiCo to cut costs after lowering earnings outlook
items.summary: PepsiCo has indicated it will cut costs after lowering its earnings outlook for 2026 on the back of margin pressures in its North America business. The post PepsiCo to cut costs after lowering earnings outlook appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Coca-Cola expands prebiotic push with “test-and-learn” NPD
items.summary: The Coca-Cola Company is testing consumer appetite for prebiotic soft drinks in the US through a pilot launch of products under three of its major brands.

items.title: Beer core but Constellation open to more outside deals
items.summary: Constellation sees beer as central to its prospects but is able “to dial in other areas of growth” after buying SpikedAde, its CEO has said.

items.title: PepsiCo Cuts Forecast, Deepens Cost Cuts As North America Recovery Drags
items.summary: PepsiCo has warned that growth and margin recovery in its key North American market was taking longer than planned.

items.title: How Olipop’s new CEO plans to reach $1B in sales
items.summary: Christian Patiño Webb says he’s focused on execution as the prebiotic soda brand faces mounting competition from a steady stream of new rivals.

items.title: Cal-Maine says egg supply is rebalancing
items.summary: Fewer hatched chicks from breeder eggs and a reduction in U.S. flock are helping ease the current glut, President and CEO Sherman Miller said.

items.title: Ghana's Cocoa Regulator Secures $288m For Farmer Purchases
items.summary: The Ghana Cocoa Board (COCOBOD) has secured 3.39 billion cedis ($288.02 million) through the issue of short-term debt on the domestic market.

items.title: REWE And Billa Wholesale Complete Leadership Restructuring
items.summary: REWE Group has completed the organisational restructuring of its wholesale divisions in Austria, following Brian Beck's relocation to Germany.

items.title: Berry Exciting – Winterwood Expands European Operations With New Division
items.summary: Berry supplier Winterwood is expanding its European operations to deliver year-round berry programmes, via Winterwood Europe.

items.title: Packaged-Food Nutrition Differs Across Europe, Product Categories – JRC
items.summary: The European Commission’s Joint Research Centre has launched an online tool showing nutritional information for packaged food.

items.title: Zalando sets up shop in France with mega-distribution center
items.summary: After five years of planning, construction, and gradual expansion, Zalando has officially opened its first mega-distribution center in France. The 140,000-square-meter complex in Montereau-sur-le-Jard, just south of Paris, will soon serve as a crucial link in the German…

items.title: Arla to close packaging plant in Sweden
items.summary: Arla is to close its Falbygdens Ost import and packaging facility in Falköping, Sweden, a decision that will impact around 60 jobs. The post Arla to close packaging plant in Sweden appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: How Dutch retailers fight back against fake online stores
items.summary: Online fraud through fake online stores is eroding consumer confidence in e-commerce. In the Netherlands, the sector is therefore launching a counteroffensive with a new tool that identifies and addresses scam online stores and fake brand domain names at an early stage.

items.title: Südzucker Expects Sugar Prices To Rebound As Lower Harvests Limit Supply
items.summary: Europe's largest sugar producer Südzucker said it expected sugar prices to rebound from their recent four-year lows.

items.title: Colruyt Group confirms talks with Carrefour regarding French wholesaler Codifrance
items.summary: Colruyt Group is indeed in exclusive negotiations with Carrefour regarding a possible sale of its French wholesale business, Codifrance, which supplies some 3,000 neighborhood stores. The retailer has thus confirmed earlier rumors.

items.title: Scotch industry lodges appeal over English whisky GI
items.summary: The Scotch Whisky Association has filed an appeal against the UK government’s approval of a Geographical Indication (GI) for English whisky.

items.title: Will Colruyt acquire 18 Belgian Carrefour supermarkets in exchange for Codifrance?
items.summary: Details regarding the possible sale of Codifrance, Colruyt’s French wholesale business, to Carrefour are not known, but according to a French newsletter, 18 Belgian Carrefour stores are also set to change hands. The retailer denies this.

items.title: From Belgian chocolate to Belgian fashion: Broeklin unveils new tenants
items.summary: Broeklin Brussels announces its first tenants. Following Celio, Neuhaus, Xandres, and Jimmyz Burgers have now also confirmed they will be joining the shopping project in Machelen. Meanwhile, construction has begun.

items.title: What barriers and opportunities face functional beverage makers?
items.summary: Industry executives at the Non-Alcoholic Beverages conference delved into issues such as the need to clarify benefits in functional drinks.

items.title: Korea Pavilion At SIAL Paris 2026: Discover, Taste And Connect With K-Food
items.summary: aT Center Paris will present the Korea Pavilion at SIAL Paris 2026, taking place from 17 to 21 October 2026 at Paris Nord Villepinte.

items.title: Amber Latvijas Balzams creditors reject repayment plan
items.summary: Amber Latvijas Balzams has applied to terminate its legal protection proceedings after creditors rejected a plan to restructure.

items.title: Keurig Dr Pepper bets on iced coffee with espresso concentrate
items.summary: The coffee giant’s new innovation will be available across four of its global coffee brands in black, caramel and mocha flavors.

items.title: How Kidults and collectibles are saving the toy market
items.summary: The Belgian toy market is having a remarkably strong year. Through September 20, sales rose by 10.1%, while the volume of goods sold was up by as much as 13%. Brick-and-mortar stores, collectibles, building sets, and card games are driving the market in particular.

items.title: Coffee Prices Rally In Central America Amid El Niño-Linked Drought
items.summary: Premiums for Central American arabica coffee have risen to their highest in around three years amid an El Niño-linked drought.

items.title: Swiss Retailers Back Strict Rules For Foreign E-Commerce Platforms
items.summary: The Swiss Retail Federation has backed proposed federal overhauls to curb regulatory imbalances for foreign online marketplaces.

items.title: Oterra teams with HowGood to track sustainability of natural colors
items.summary: As demand for natural dyes expands, companies are investing in environmental reporting and other metrics that are commonplace within more mainstream ingredients.

items.title: French Honey Production Projected To Fall 2.5% Amid Heatwaves
items.summary: French honey production is set to fall 2.5% in 2026 amid heatwaves and weather hazards, according to an Agrex Consulting survey for InterApi.

items.title: Luxury pastry shop Wittamer receives 3.8 million euros in fresh capital for restructuring and expansion
items.summary: The owners of the Brussels-based pastry shop Wittamer are injecting 3.8 million euros into the company. With this fresh capital, the purveyor to the royal court aims to restore its balance sheet, open new stores, and build a new production facility.

items.title: AI Recommendations Increasingly Important For Consumers – NIQ
items.summary: AI recommendations are becoming increasingly important, as 55% of consumers are occasionally influenced by them, according to NIQ.

items.title: Mission Produce sets 2035 sales, earnings targets
items.summary: Mission Produce has set out a plan to double sales and triple adjusted EBITDA by 2035. The post Mission Produce sets 2035 sales, earnings targets appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Refresco Plots Potential IPO At $10bn-Plus Valuation, Sources Say
items.summary: Refresco and its owner KKR took pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on a potential initial public offering, sources told Reuters.
